options.text: In both jars. Meat makes maggots.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "The maggots come from inside the meat, so cloth cannot stop them."

options.text: Only in the covered jar, because it is warmer under the cloth.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Covered things go bad faster."

image.alt: Two glass jars of meat on a windowsill, one open with flies hovering, the other covered with a fine cloth.
